card.name: Reggada
card.tagline: Morocco's Rif Berber dance — shoulders rolling, rifles raised in air, the celebration dance of the Riffi mountain communities.
card.profile: Reggada is a traditional dance and musical genre of Morocco specific to the Amazigh tribes of the north-east (provinces of Oujda, Berkane and Taourirt).
card.insight: Reggada has crossed from rural Rif weddings into mainstream Moroccan and Algerian pop music — modern artists like Cheb Mimoun el-Oujdi and Stati have made reggada one of the most-played styles at urban celebrations from Casablanca to Marseille's Moroccan diaspora. The dance's signature shoulder roll has been borrowed into raï and modern fusion across the Maghreb.
